name: personal-os
description: Personal OS — agent-native control panel and personal software factory.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @personal-os/contracts && npm run build -w @personal-os/agent-adapters && npm run build -w @personal-os/server && npm run build -w @personal-os/worker && npm run build -w @personal-os/web
scripts.build:deps: npm run build -w @personal-os/contracts && npm run build -w @personal-os/agent-adapters && npm run build -w @personal-os/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:deps && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:deps && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @personal-os/web
